notes.title: Reverse Defense Demo is out now! Check out our Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re thrilled to share that the demo for Reverse Defense is now available to play!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/poligames/reverse-defense?ref=27yspt]We’ve also launched our Kickstarter campaign, where you can join us in bringing the game to life. Share your thoughts, give feedback, and have a hand in shaping the final version of Reverse Defense.
